name: Dreams
q: Even a silly dream is what you make of it
Without dreams, there's nowhere to go
Revere the dreams of your youth
Those who envision dreams achieve them
If you can dream it, you can do it
Go confidently in the direction of your dreams
Dreamers of the day act with open eyes
A dream is the fulfilment of a wish
We are such stuff as dreams are made on
You dream a flower and wake holding it
Life is a dream, and dreams themselves are dreams
Be always drunken — with poetry, with virtue, with what you will
